### Description
fix #6907.  #7395 
Now vite use `rollup.watch` in watch mode.And `rollup.watch` use resolveId to locate file.
Now vite resolve id with query (eg: ?raw for external and ?used for internal).It will break file watching.
So add a plugin to help watching file.

issue_context.title: Vite build --watch does not trigger reload when imported Sass module changes
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug ## Aim Build a component library using Vite and Sass modules (e.g. `MyComponent.module.scss` ) ## Steps to reproduce 1. Clone reproduction repo 2. `npm install` 3. `npm start` 4. Make a change to `src/components/MyComponent/MyComponent.module.scss` ## Result - Vite does not detect the change - Vite does not rebuild the library to `./dist` - `./dist/style.css` is not updated to reflect the change ## Expected result - Vite detects the change - Vite rebuilds the library to `./dist` - `./dist/style.css` is updated to reflect the change ## Workaround Add the following line to `src/components/MyComponent/index.tsx` Achieves expected result ```diff import styles from "./MyComponent.module.scss"; +import "./MyComponent.module.scss"; export default function MyComponent() { return
hi
; } ``` ### Reproduction https://github.com/lokimckay-references/vite-sass-modules ### System Info ```shell System: OS: Windows 10 10.0.19042 CPU: (24) x64 AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor Memory: 6.85 GB / 15.93 GB Binaries: Node: 16.13.2 - C:\dev\apps\nodejs\node.EXE Yarn: 1.22.5 - C:\dev\apps\Yarn\bin\yarn.CMD npm: 8.1.2 - C:\dev\apps\nodejs\npm.CMD Browsers: Edge: Spartan (44.19041.1266.0), Chromium (98.0.1108.50) Internet Explorer: 11.0.19041.1202 ``` ### Used Package Manager npm ### Logs _No response_ ### Validations - [X] Follow our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] Read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). - [X] Read the [docs](https://vitejs.dev/guide). - [X] Check that there isn't [already an issue](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues) that reports the same bug to avoid creating a duplicate. - [X] Make sure this is a Vite issue and not a framework-specific issue. For example, if it's a Vue SFC related bug, it should likely be reported to https://github.com/vuejs/core instead. - [X] Check that this is a concrete bug. For Q&A open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/discussions) or join our [Discord Chat Server](https://chat.vitejs.dev/). - [X] The provided reproduction is a [minimal reproducible example](https://stackoverflow.com/help/minimal-reproducible-example) of the bug.

Just have a thought about this. If the id is not an actual file path, but matches the `queryRE`, would this be safe to call?

I think a couple cases where this could happen is e.g. path aliases and virtual modules.

Thanks for review!

> I think a couple cases where this could happen is e.g. path aliases and virtual modules.

In the current implementation,the virtual modules and path alias already exists in the rollup watchFile list.What i do is adding the correct id in it.
And in rollup, `chokidar` has own implementation to filter the incorrect id.IMO, it would be safe to call it.
Cool, thanks for the explanation! If this fix had also work for you locally, then this seems like a safe change then
